zh: 字符串重复 K 次后总长可达一百万，直接模拟删除虽然可行但没必要：每轮都删掉一半，幸存者在原序列中的下标始终构成等差数列。
只需维护等差数列的首项 head、公差 step 和剩余个数 count。每轮公差翻倍、个数减半；关键是判断这一轮首项是否被删掉。
count=|S|×K，head=0，step=1，方向从左开始；当 count>1 时：若本轮从左删，或从右删且 count 为奇数，则 head+=step；然后 count/=2、step*=2、换方向；最后输出 S[head mod |S|]。
en: After repeating the string K times the length can reach one million. Simulation is possible but unnecessary: each round removes half of the characters, and the surviving original indices always form an arithmetic progression.
Keep only the first term head, the common difference step and the remaining count. Each round doubles the step and halves the count; the key question is whether this round removes the first term.

Set count = |S| * K, head = 0, step = 1, starting from the left; while count > 1: if this round deletes from the left, or deletes from the right and count is odd, add step to head; then halve count, double step and switch direction; finally print S[head mod |S|].

explanationEn:
## Approach

The surviving original indices always form an arithmetic progression. Maintain the first term head, the step and the remaining count. A deletion from the left always moves the first term; a deletion from the right moves it only when the count is odd.

## Correctness

Each round keeps half of the terms of the arithmetic progression, so the new step doubles. A deletion from the left removes the original first term; a deletion from the right removes the original first term if and only if the number of terms is odd. Update this way until only one term is left; its original index modulo |S| gives the corresponding character.

## Complexity

Time O(log(|S| K)), extra space O(1).
